**BURAU REPRESENTATION OF BRAID GROUPS AND q-RATIONALS**

*SOPHIE MORIER-GENOUD, VALENTIN OVSIENKO, AND ALEXANDER VESELOV*

10 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** We establish a link between the new theory of q-deformed ratio- nal numbers and the classical Burau representation of the braid group B3. We apply this link to the open problem of classiﬁcation of faithful complex spe- cializations of this representation. As a result we provide an answer to this problem in terms of the singular set of the q-rationals and prove the faithful- ness of the Burau representation specialized at complex t ∈C∗outside the annulus 3 −2 √ 2 ≤|t| ≤3 + 2 √ 2.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 q-rationals and q-deformed modular group; 2.2 Matrices of continued fractions; 2.3 Some properties of the polynomials R and S; 3 Proof of the main theorems; 4 Discussion; References
